data.Job_Description: About Quadeye Quadeye is an algorithmic trading firm operating across major global financial markets and exchanges. We combine quantitative research, advanced mathematical modeling, and high-performance technology to develop sophisticated automated trading strategies across diverse asset classes. Our teams work at the intersection of markets, mathematics, statistics, and technology, with significant ownership across the entire strategy lifecycle—from research and ideation to implementation, deployment, and optimization. We offer a highly meritocratic environment where talented researchers and engineers have the opportunity to work on challenging problems, access world-class infrastructure, and see the direct impact of their work on live trading performance. The Role We are looking for a Full Stack Engineering Intern to build and enhance internal applications and tools that support our Quant, Infrastructure, Compliance, and Operations teams. You will work on real-world problems in a fast-paced trading environment, collaborating with different teams to understand their requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions. You will have the opportunity to propose solution approaches, make thoughtful design decisions, and contribute across the development lifecycle—from implementation and testing to deployment and monitoring. Problem Discovery → Solution Design → Development → Testing → Deployment → Monitoring What You’ll Do • Build and enhance in-house web applications used across our trading and business teams. • Develop tools for data manipulation, trade monitoring, and operational workflows. • Improve the user experience, reliability, and performance of existing internal systems and applications. • Work closely with Quant, Infrastructure, Compliance, and Operations teams to understand requirements and solve real-world problems. • Evaluate different technical approaches and contribute to design decisions based on scalability, reliability, and user requirements. • Contribute across development, testing, deployment, and post-deployment monitoring. • Identify opportunities to automate workflows and improve the efficiency of internal processes. • Collaborate with engineers and users to build scalable, efficient, and maintainable solutions. Requirements • Pursuing an engineering degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline. • Experience with Python web development, preferably using Django. • Knowledge of front-end technologies including HTML, JavaScript, and frameworks such as React or Angular. • Experience with scripting using Shell, Perl, and/or Python. • Familiarity with Linux/Unix-based operating systems. • Understanding of AWS services such as ELB, Lambda, EC2, and Route 53. • Good understanding of operating systems and system design fundamentals. • Ability to work effectively across multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a willingness to learn new technologies. • Strong written and verbal communication skills. • Knowledge of financial markets or the financial industry is advantageous but not required.

About Quadeye Quadeye is an algorithmic trading firm operating across major global financial markets and exchanges. We combine quantitative research, advanced mathematical modeling, and high-performance technology to develop sophisticated automated trading strategies across diverse asset classes. Our teams work at the intersection of markets, mathematics, statistics, and technology, with significant ownership across the entire strategy lifecycle—from research and ideation to implementation, deployment, and optimization. We offer a highly meritocratic environment where talented researchers and engineers have the opportunity to work on challenging problems, access world-class infrastructure, and see the direct impact of their work on live trading performance. The Role We are looking for a Systems Engineering Intern to join our Latency Systems team and work on the high-performance technology that powers our trading operations. You will work at the intersection of operating systems, networking, CPU architecture, and high-performance software, contributing to real-time systems engineered for nanosecond-level latency. You will learn how to identify performance bottlenecks, optimize critical execution paths, and build reliable systems where every CPU cycle matters. You will work closely with systems engineers, quantitative researchers, traders, and infrastructure teams while contributing across the systems engineering lifecycle: Design → Development → Performance Engineering → Testing → Deployment → Optimization What You’ll Do • Design and develop components for real-time trade execution and risk management systems with stringent latency and reliability requirements. • Profile critical execution paths to identify bottlenecks and improve system latency, throughput, and predictability. • Optimize performance across CPU utilization, memory management, cache behavior, operating systems, and compiler-level execution. • Explore low-latency systems concepts including kernel internals, CPU affinity, interrupts, clock sources, NUMA, and CPU microarchitecture. • Research and experiment with high-performance networking stacks and kernel bypass technologies. • Design and optimize algorithms and cache-efficient data structures for performance-critical workloads. • Explore lock-free and wait-free approaches where appropriate for latency-sensitive systems. • Build monitoring and diagnostic tools to analyze CPU cycles, network throughput, memory allocation, and system latency. • Contribute across requirements gathering, system design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. • Collaborate with engineers, quantitative researchers, traders, and infrastructure teams to improve the performance and reliability of our trading systems. Requirements • Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline, preferably from a leading academic institution. • Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming. • Strong programming skills in C++ or C. • Good understanding of operating systems, Linux, and system-level programming concepts. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an interest in understanding systems at a low level. • Curiosity about performance engineering, operating system internals, networking, and computer architecture. • Familiarity with low-level debugging, profiling, or performance analysis tools is advantageous. • Knowledge of Python, Perl, R, or other scripting languages is a plus. • Ability to work effectively on multiple priorities in a fast-paced technical environment. • Strong communication and collaboration skills with a willingness to learn quickly and take ownership. Benefits

About Quadeye Quadeye is an algorithmic trading firm operating across major global financial markets and exchanges. We combine quantitative research, advanced mathematical modeling, and high-performance technology to develop sophisticated automated trading strategies across diverse asset classes. Our teams work at the intersection of markets, mathematics, statistics, and technology, with significant ownership across the entire strategy lifecycle—from research and ideation to implementation, deployment, and optimization. We offer a highly meritocratic environment where talented researchers and engineers have the opportunity to work on challenging problems, access world-class infrastructure, and see the direct impact of their work on live trading performance. The Roles We are looking for exceptional individuals to join Quadeye across two high-impact tracks: Systems Engineer and Quantitative Strategist. Both roles offer the opportunity to solve challenging problems at the intersection of technology, quantitative research, and financial markets. Systems Engineer As a Systems Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize the high-performance systems that power our proprietary trading strategies. You will work on real-time infrastructure engineered for nanosecond-level latency, solving complex performance challenges across operating systems, kernels, networking, CPU architecture, and software. Design → Development → Performance Engineering → Testing → Production → Optimization What You’ll Do – Systems Engineer • Design and implement real-time trade execution and risk systems with nanosecond-level latency requirements. • Identify, analyze, and eliminate performance bottlenecks to make systems faster and more efficient. • Research and implement opportunities to reduce latency across operating systems, kernels, and networking stacks. • Explore performance optimization techniques involving kernel bypass, CPU architecture, algorithms, and cache-efficient data structures. • Collaborate closely with engineers and quantitative researchers to build robust, scalable, and performance-critical system components. Quantitative Strategist As a Quantitative Strategist, you will research, develop, and implement automated trading strategies across different exchanges, asset classes, and trading frequencies. You will work with large-scale market datasets, apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to identify trading opportunities, and translate successful research into highly optimized strategies for live trading. You will collaborate closely with quantitative researchers and software engineers to solve challenging problems across research, modeling, and implementation. Research → Signal Development → Backtesting → Implementation → Production → Optimization What You’ll Do – Quantitative Strategist • Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to identify trading opportunities from large-scale market datasets. • Research and develop systematic trading strategies across different exchanges, asset classes, and frequencies. • Design and implement strategies in highly optimized, production-quality code. • Take successful research from prototyping and testing through live production deployment. • Analyze live strategy performance and continuously develop new approaches to improve the speed and accuracy of predictions. Requirements Systems Engineer • Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming. • Strong programming fundamentals, preferably in C++ or C. • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. • Interest in high-performance systems, low-latency engineering, operating systems, networking, and computer architecture. • Working knowledge of Linux-based environments. • Familiarity with Python, Perl, R, or functional programming is advantageous. • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. • Strong communication and collaboration skills with a high degree of ownership. Quantitative Strategist • Strong quantitative aptitude with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. • Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming. • Strong programming fundamentals, preferably in C++ or C. • Strong interest in financial markets, quantitative research, and systematic trading. • Working knowledge of Linux-based environments. • Knowledge of Python, Perl, R, or functional programming is advantageous. • Ability to manage multiple priorities and thrive in a fast-paced environment. • Strong communication and collaboration skills with a high degree of ownership. Eligibility Criteria • Eligible programs: B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering, B.Tech Mathematics & Computing, B.Tech Electrical Engineering, and Dual Degree programs in these disciplines. • Minimum CGPA: 8.5 • No active backlogs at the time of application or during the selection process.
